achievements.name: The Music Enjoyer
achievements.description: Play at least 20 tracks

achievements.name: S Apprentice
achievements.description: Receive an "S" score on one track

achievements.name: S Associate
achievements.description: Receive an "S" score on five tracks

achievements.name: S Aficionado
achievements.description: Receive an "S" score on ten tracks

achievements.name: S Virtuoso
achievements.description: Receive an "S" score on fifteen tracks

achievements.name: S GOD
achievements.description: Receive an "S" score on twenty or more tracks

achievements.name: I Would Prefer Not To
achievements.description: Abstain from tooting

achievements.name: The Tootmaster
achievements.description: Get an "S" score on 4 different tracks first. Then, from the Main Menu, click "Baboon" to reach a dimly lit room; click the hatch to inspect it, click all 4 "S" corners then the center to unlock it, then spam-click the hatch to meet Tootmaster Tom, the game's Toot Vessel character.

achievements.name: The Bassmaster
achievements.description: Obtain a copy of the Bass Clef card (#23), open your Collection, click the card to view its full-size art, then spam-click the card art itself. This drops you into a dimly lit room with a hatch on the left and the Turdvessel's silhouette on the right - meet Bassmaster Ben, the game's Turd Vessel character, to unlock it.

achievements.name: Aesthete
achievements.description: Unlock a trombone color

achievements.name: Apex Aesthete
achievements.description: Unlock all trombone colors

achievements.name: Gettin' Tootier
achievements.description: Unlock a Sound Set

achievements.name: Got Tootiest
achievements.description: Unlock all Sound Sets

achievements.name: Yo! I Got a Sack
achievements.description: Get a sack

achievements.name: Card Collector
achievements.description: Get 50 Tromboner Cards

achievements.name: New Friend
achievements.description: In the Card Collection screen, look in the bottom-right corner for a small candle icon. Spam-click it to summon a new friend and unlock the achievement.

achievements.name: Never Liked the Guy
achievements.description: Turd your last Mozart card

achievements.name: No more
achievements.description: Abstain from sound completely

achievements.name: I Want Them All!
achievements.description: Express your love of baboons

achievements.name: TROMBONE CHAMP
achievements.description: Become the Trombone Champ of Legend

achievements.name: Big Brain Scholar
achievements.description: Develop an enormous brain full of facts

achievements.name: S ULTRA-GOD
achievements.description: Receive an "S" score on twenty-five or more tracks

achievements.name: S ULTRA-MEGA-GOD
achievements.description: Receive an "S" score on thirty or more tracks

achievements.name: I DID ENGOLDENATION
achievements.description: Collect 10 copies of the same Tromboner Card, then select and confirm the "Engoldenate" prompt on it - the 10 duplicates combine into a single card with a gold border instead of the usual blue one. (Turding an Engoldenated card removes the effect, so you would need to collect 10 copies again.)

achievements.name: ENGOLDENATION GOD
achievements.description: The follow-up to Engoldenating a single card: repeat the same 10-copies-into-one "Engoldenate" process (see I DID ENGOLDENATION) until every unique card in your Collection has been converted to its gold-bordered Engoldenated version.
